name: scheduling
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when scheduling moves to a different clock source (e.g. a native plugin cron API) or when the tick interval/route become config-driven and this slice's hardcoding is removed.
spec_change_reason: status.py warns when the project-local config.json is missing/empty (the wrong-anchor / unconfigured trap where run_tick silently falls back to shipped-default governance: empty issue_filter + aggressive auto-merge, pulling ALL open issues). status resolves config_path=<runtime_dir>/config.json and computes local_config_present (True ONLY when the file exists AND parses to a non-empty dict; absent/empty{}/invalid -> False, never crashes). status_data() exposes config_path + local_config_present; render_status shows a loud ASCII warning naming config_path + the shipped-defaults/auto-merge trap when absent, and a quiet 'config <path>' confirmation when present. --json emits the fields; --line legacy one-liner unchanged; no SKILL.md change. feature.json advanced 0.48.0 -> 0.50.0 to reconcile the prior lag behind spec.md 0.49.0.
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md was already advanced to 0.50.0 (local-config presence warning) by the dispatcher's spec-update commit d9f0cc2 before this TDD cycle; this cycle implements that spec in status.py
